## Full Service Landscaping & Hardscape Contractor

## Landscape Design, Installation, & Property Maintenance Services from the Local Experts

When you look at your backyard, what do you see? Grass and a few trees, maybe some flowers if you were proactive in your gardening this spring. Now for the tough question – What do you want to see? A uniquely shaped in-ground pool, complimented by a stone patio, steps, a grill station and bar? Whether this is your landscaping dream, or something else entirely, Stubbs Landscaping will make it a reality.

Our award-winning landscape architect, Justin Rinehimer, and his team of landscaping professionals have over 30 years of combined experience designing and constructing beautiful outdoor areas. From small projects like a patio or gazebo, to full outdoor living areas with a kitchen or waterfall, Stubbs Landscaping will create a design that is beautiful, maintainable, and perfect for relaxing and entertaining guests.

To get started, submit a **[contact form](https://stubbslandscaping.com/contact/)**, or give us a call at **[(570) 760-6813](tel:(570) 760-6813)**. We’d love to hear from you!

[Request Quote](https://stubbslandscaping.com/contact/)

## What We Do

![landing](https://stubbslandscaping.com/wp-content/uploads/elementor/thumbs/landing-qiqswenkzbrtpm4yc4ujowdwu9ah77ssu34kjbjmwo.jpg)

## PRECISION CRAFTED

## Landscaping

We provide a wide range of landscape and lawn care services including mowing, edging, spring and fall clean-up, over-seeding, pruning, lawn installation, mulching, shrub installation, planting flowers and trees.

[Get Landscape Quote](https://stubbslandscaping.com/landscape-services/)

![Patio 2](https://stubbslandscaping.com/wp-content/uploads/elementor/thumbs/Patio-2-qixoxdx4c0vf72aod8guv7aqh1hjfi8a4fkk7mgi48.jpg)

## BUILT TO LAST

## Hardscaping

Hardscape is something that can transform the way you look at a particular area. Anything from patios, fire pits, hardscape repair, sitting walls, paver paths, aggregate paths, and water features. We can help with any hardscape project.

[Design My Patio](https://stubbslandscaping.com/hardscape-services/)

![Stubbs 2](https://stubbslandscaping.com/wp-content/uploads/elementor/thumbs/Stubbs-2-qiqmfuf41zev6ty3c3wja339r9k5r5jlv0eqzqd8e0.jpg)

## Let your imagination soar

## Outdoor Living

From outdoor kitchens, fire pits, and stone patios to garden sitting areas, paved walkways, and full designs combining these aspects alongside a pool, Stubbs Landscaping can do this and everything in between.

[Request Design Consult](https://stubbslandscaping.com/outdoor-living/)

![Plunge Piool Builder](https://stubbslandscaping.com/wp-content/uploads/elementor/thumbs/Plunge-Piool-Builder-r12ca6djee73yez4y41mt8sldrborlrzc1qd8hqyew.jpeg)

## DESIGNED FOR RELAXATION

## POOLS

Whether you’re looking for a compact plunge pool or a fully integrated backyard feature, we design and install pool solutions that fit your space and lifestyle. From [**Plunge Pools**](https://stubbslandscaping.com/plunge-pools/) to [**Soake Pools**](https://stubbslandscaping.com/soake-pools/) and [**Bayto Pools**](https://stubbslandscaping.com/bayto-pools/), our team handles the process from concept to completion.

[Explore Pool Options](https://stubbslandscaping.com/plunge-pools/)

![IMG_4590](https://stubbslandscaping.com/wp-content/uploads/elementor/thumbs/IMG_4590-scaled-rimjkjly5z6fwk3cpeezkkjfhuik29f7onbk80ij7c.jpg)

## CUSTOM BUILT

## DECKS

A well-designed deck extends your living space and brings people together. Stubbs Landscaping specializes in custom deck construction, offering wood and composite options designed to complement your home and outdoor environment.

[Start Deck Build](https://stubbslandscaping.com/custom-deck-builder/)

![iStock-172200365 (1)](https://stubbslandscaping.com/wp-content/uploads/elementor/thumbs/iStock-172200365-1-ria6nx13ixmge54yk4iaob6kvefk8citlpbqz0izso.jpg)

## ROOTED IN RESULTS

## LAWN HEALTH

A healthy lawn starts below the surface. Our lawn health services focus on strengthening your turf through aeration, seeding, overseeding, and soil improvement to promote thicker growth, reduce bare spots, and restore the overall health of your lawn.

[Restore My Lawn](https://stubbslandscaping.com/lawn-health-services/)
